checks.reason: A=SR^-1 J Sy and b=SR^-1 R are built once; augmented Gauss-Jordan maximum-absolute partial row pivots solve A z=-b while forming its inverse. Delta=Sy z has the correct sign. Norms are vector max and matrix maximum absolute row sum. Recomputed A z+b and its denominator implement the frozen normwise linear backward-error formula, including zero/zero. Fixed4x4 storage/work is bounded.

Only computed exact-zero pivots trigger singular HOLD; finite large condition estimates remain reported. Input bool/nonfinite/malformed/shape/nonpositive-scale checks and finite arithmetic guards match the contract. kappa and backward error are binary64 estimates, not certified inverse or nonlinear bounds; no guarantee is made for all extreme-scale or near-singular inputs.

Native scales use max(abs(old_w),abs(w),1e-6); state scales use species floor1e-5 and current-energy floor1e-6. The adapter checks physical old/current states, required positive stage quantities, supplied exact evaluation-state equality and shared nonempty context IDs, method/order/energy-unit conventions, labeled Jacobian kind and frozen source blob. ACTUAL_STAGE additionally requires accepted-stage status, explicit provenance/cost fields and native norm<=1e-11.

Same-state/context/source validation concerns declared packet contents in the trusted owner workflow. The module does not reconstruct telemetry or independently validate a remote producer/receipt; ACTUAL_STAGE status is conditional on an honestly supplied packet. Fabricated actual-shaped C6 controls test those guards and do not establish observed actual telemetry. The null template correctly HOLDs.

T=2w/(3kD), linear=T*(dw/w-dD/D), exact_map=linear/(1+dD/D) match the reviewed frozen formulas. The exact-map formula avoids subtracting close absolute temperatures; ordinary cancellation/rounding remains. Invalid corrected ionic/energy domain preserves the linear diagnostic and returns null exact projection/corrected temperature with a reason. No corrected state is committed. The exact_map label means algebraic EOS evaluation, not exact arithmetic or evolved-temperature error.

Current source pin is immutable and matching is required for the present adapter. SOURCE_BINDING_HANDOFF.md correctly treats a future observer-induced blob change as a focused equation/scale/context/acceptance seam migration under existing owner authorization. It adds no present producer mutation or fresh execution permission gate; unaffected derivations/fixtures remain reusable.

Standalone imports standard library only. Fresh output prevents overwrite; missing input produces typed HOLD/null metrics and exit2; success exits0. Finite JSON results and measured receipt are separately written with same-directory temporary files, flush/fsync and atomic replacement, followed by supported directory fsync. Receipt records actual input/module hashes, argv, environment, elapsed time and outcome. Atomicity is per file; both files comprise completed output.

C6 actual six test cases passed. C7 actual two methods cover seven cached matrix cases and five adapter/EOS cases; cached exact oracle identity matches and was not rerun. C8 actual three small cases cover finite high conditioning, consistent power-of-two rescaling and unequal old/current energy scales. Static review and these targeted executions resolve this unit scope without optional broad replay.
